verdict.rationale: An IaC tool or platform like Terraform/HCP Terraform could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an MCP server that gives external AI models access to Terraform docs, modules and workspaces. That is a building block for third-party agents, not an assistant inside the product that users delegate tasks to. Nothing in the pack documents an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
